description: Records whether the participant is coming to the plan's Event: yes, no, or clear to remove the answer. For a repeating event it answers one occurrence (the next one by default, or occurrence_date). Use when the user says they are or are not attending.

occurrence_date.description: Repeating events only: the date of the occurrence to answer for.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.

name: set_rsvp
title: Answer the RSVP
